## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem and what changes for the user. Keep the PR focused.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results, plus important checks not run.
For rendering/runtime changes, include revision, hardware, OS/toolkit, model/DLL identity,
input/output geometry, arithmetic mode and reference identity. Separate synthetic output,
in-game generation, presentation, visual quality and performance evidence.

## Source and data provenance

- [ ] I can explain the implementation and have reviewed all changed code.
- [ ] Imported/adapted material has its origin, license and required notices recorded.
- [ ] No model weights, DLLs, SDK binaries, game assets, private captures, credentials or personal data are added.
- [ ] Failures and missing references remain visible; thresholds were not weakened to obtain a pass.

## Compatibility and recovery

Describe affected SR/FG/NR/app paths, fallback/reset behavior and any migration or rollback impact.
Write "not applicable" when this does not affect runtime behavior.

## AI assistance

State whether AI helped find, implement or test the change, and how you independently checked it.
The contributor remains responsible for correctness, provenance and explanation.
